title: A tracked-priority row names its branch and reads its PR by REST at each wake
why: The consultant's handoff said "no PR yet" while #3302 existed.
source: Consultant 20:27 CST Nov 13; triage did not check #3302 or the handoff.
note: Filed 20:28 CST Nov 13. Fix: each tracked-priority row in a standing session's handoff or table carries its branch, and the wake reads that branch's PR state by REST (counts and states from REST, rule verification-counts-from-rest) before a "no PR yet" claim stands. Pairs with priority-vs-merge-order. Duplicate check owed: similar steps in the handoff family (handoff-ledger-step-one, cite-check-covers-handoffs); the lane reads them first. Needs a lane. Coordinator 20:30 CST Nov 13 (20:29): lane started (Sonnet, medium; searches open PRs for a duplicate first), session_013NEJKz6CH8YwNg3W3wWq2n. Lane via the coordinator 22:30 CST Nov 13 (22:30): PR #3337 (draft, head aabb9966ce5f), lane lint PASS, record posted, 3 rounds, net value positive (the lane's word). Row form the check reads: `priority: <slug> | pr: <owner>/<repo>#<N>` or `| branch: <name>`, optional `repo: <owner>/<repo>`. Tool: `merge --priority-rows FILE|-`. Row home: the batch runner's handoff `## Priorities` section.
